stats.label: Manager archetypes
stats.description: What fifteen years of results say about each manager, in one phrase. Every label is the measure that manager is furthest from the league average on — narrow losses, how far their scores swing, how much the schedule has flattered them — and the number behind it is in the line. Managers with fewer than 40 games are left out.

entries.subject: hadkiss
entries.detail: The Cat Burglar — 26 wins by under five points, most in the league — wins nothing by a distance and everything by a whisker

entries.subject: thd
entries.detail: The Heartbreaker — 23 losses by under five points, most in the league

entries.subject: sol
entries.detail: The Punchbag — loses by 29.6 points on average, the largest in the league — which is not losing so much as being disposed of

entries.subject: fin
entries.detail: The Metronome — scores swing by only ±18.1 points week to week, the narrowest in the league — the same thing, every Sunday, forever

entries.subject: kitch
entries.detail: The Trapdoor — 32 weeks spent in the bottom tenth of every score this league has ever posted, most in the league

entries.subject: htc
entries.detail: The Closer — 43% through Week 6, 59% from Week 9 — a surge of 17 percentage points, the steepest surge in the league

entries.subject: jay
entries.detail: The Rollercoaster — scores swing by ±23.2 points week to week, the widest in the league — nobody, himself included, knows which team turns up

entries.subject: nick
entries.detail: The Machine — 100.6 points a week across a whole career, the highest average in the league

entries.subject: chris
entries.detail: The Anchor — 87.0 points a week across a whole career, the lowest average in the league — a fixture everyone else pencils in as a win

entries.subject: dix
entries.detail: The Bully — wins by 28.2 points on average, 2nd of 14 in the league — does not so much win as make a point

entries.subject: ant
entries.detail: The Fraud — wins 53% of his regular-season games on scores that beat only 51% of the league — 2.2 percentage points of pure fixture luck, 3rd of 14 in the league

entries.subject: brock
entries.detail: The September Hero — 50% through Week 6, 40% from Week 9 — a fade of 10 percentage points, 4th of 14 in the league

entries.subject: ryan
entries.detail: The Nearly Man — his scores beat 47% of the league but he wins only 46% of his regular-season games — 1.5 percentage points handed back by the schedule, 3rd of 14 in the league

entries.subject: rich
entries.detail: The Iron Man — 222 games played, 4th of 14 in the league — has outlasted managers, teams and at least one league format

stats.label: When the title was decided
stats.description: Looking back at each championship: the week after which the eventual champion never again fell out of the top half of the playoff places — the top three of six, or the top two of four in the early years. Ranked on the standings after every week, by record then points scored. The earlier the week, the less doubt there ever was; 'never' means they were still outside that group on the last day and won it regardless.
